item.title: Persistent Progress #jamuary2026 — Novation Peak w/ Deluge and light Synth Candy
One Synth Challenge - Part 2
item.description: video upload by Jason DeRoche Music "In this video, I revisit the One Synth Challenge and perform an entire song using only the Sequential Take 5. 🎹 Every sound comes straight from this synth, utilizing its powerful oscillators, modulation possibilities and internal effects. Some chorus is also applied at the mixing stage in Logic. 🎧 Headphones recommended 🎛️ One synth. One song. #

item.title: Talk ‘N Learn Alphabet – Unleashing Demons & Chipmunks
item.description: video upload by Manitou Productions "Today's feature is the Talk N' Learn Alphabet by Scientific Toys: made sometime in the early 90's (I think). We test a unit that has wonky pitch, and explore how to make it even wonkier (and eventually fix it); then we'll look at a modified example. The alphabet never sounded so scary!" Chapters: 0:00 Did I do that? 0:07 Titles 0:15 Intro 1:04 Let’s turn it
